hero.title: Reliable trading. Professional solutions.
hero.lead: Premier is a diversified trading and supply company providing automotive spare parts and tyres, food products, building materials, import and export, procurement, tender supply and professional business services.

about.title: Building business through trust and reliable supply.
about.lead: Premier Projects for Food Trading & Services is a multi-sector trading and supply company serving businesses, contractors, organizations and procurement teams with a wide range of products and services.
about.summary: Our portfolio enables us to respond to different procurement requirements through reliable sourcing, competitive pricing, efficient supply and professional customer service. From automotive parts and tyres to food items, building materials, import/export and tender supply, we work toward practical solutions around each customer's specifications.
